text:
IncidentBot: P1 - Inference error spike in west1. 503s and token drops reported. Pager triggered for SRE-Oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-178

SRE-Oncall: got it, investigating. I'm on the bridge. @Alex can you check model serving pods?

Alex: looking now. seeing elevated 5xx from model-worker-3 in west1. Restarted it, still errors. KV cache timeouts in logs.

Maria: seeing latency uptick on Dedicated pool, impacting a few customers. I’ll notify CS for affected accounts.

Jamal: I can take comms. Heads up: my shift ends at 02:45 UTC — who will drive at handoff?

SRE-Oncall: Plan: Alex = driver, Tara = secondary/bridge, Jamal = comms. Incoming oncall Chris to take formal ownership at 03:05 UTC. If still active at 02:40 we do warm handoff on bridge.

Tara: I can bridge 02:40-03:05 to avoid the 02:45 coverage gap. :clock3: 

Chris: I’ll be available to take over at 03:05. Please leave any runbook steps in-thread.

Alex: runbook snippets:
```
# quick checks
1) tail -n 200 /var/log/model-worker-3.log
2) curl -sS http://localhost:9000/kv/health || report
3) systemctl restart model-worker-3
4) if restart fails: curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/failover -d '{"target":"worker-1"}'
```

Maria: Customer impact: Searchlytics=40% errors, Chatly=intermittent latency. CS assigned to Searchlytics and notified. ETA for mitigation ~25-35m.

Jamal: Comms update going out now: "Investigating higher-than-normal errors affecting inference requests in west1. Mitigation underway. Updates every 15m. Contact @Jamal for urgent questions." :loudspeaker: 

SRE-Oncall: Official assignments: driver=Alex, comms=Jamal, secondary=Tara, incoming=Chris. Logging this in incident tracker and will mark handoff when Chris confirms.

IncidentBot: Incident state changed: investigating -> mitigation_in_progress. Updated severity: P1. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-178

Chris: Confirmed, I'll take ownership at 03:05. If anything spikes before then ping me directly.

Tara: Monitoring dashboards and alerts. I'll keep the bridge open and surface any regressions.

Alex: If failover required I’ll coordinate with infra to provision additional workers. Heads up: may take ~10m.

Jamal: Posted update to affected customers and internal #cs-alerts. Next status update at +15m.

SRE-Oncall: Thanks all. Once Chris confirms takeover mark thread with final handoff note. If we still active past 03:30 escalate to oncall lead.

Chris: Took ownership at 03:05 UTC — driver now. Will produce a short postmortem after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
